links.outcome: Reading grade level of existing pediatric otolaryngology patient education materials versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: AAO-HNS materials averaged 10.71 ± 0.71 grade level; combined AAO-HNS and hospital materials averaged 9.32 ± 1.82; only 1 of 7 children's hospitals was below sixth-grade level.
links.quote: Of the 7 children's hospitals, only 1 institution had an average grade level below the recommended sixth-grade level.

links.outcome: Readability grade level of patient education materials before and after ChatGPT simplification to fifth-grade level
links.effect: AAO-HNS materials fell from 10.71 ± 0.71 to 7.9 ± 1.18 (P<.01); combined materials fell from 9.32 ± 1.82 to 7.68 ± 1.12 (P=.0598); not all materials reached recommended level.
links.quote: However, it did not possess the capability to reduce all materials to be below the recommended reading level.

links.effect: Average grade level fell from 9.32 ± 1.82 to 7.68 ± 1.12 (P = .0598); not all materials were below recommended level.
